title: kubeadm should confirm that the new etcd peer has started before trying to promote it to a member, and even remove the unstarted peer
description:
What would you like to be added?
I think kubeadm should confirm that the new etcd peer has started. If it is has not (e.g. because the etcd image is unavailable, or kubelet has stopped), then kubeadm should not try to promote it to a member, and should eventually remove the member.

Why is this needed?
When kubeadm joins a control plane node with local etcd, it

Makes an etcd API call to add a new etcd peer as a learner.
Creates the etcd static pod
Makes an API call to promote the learner to a member
For (3) to complete, the etcd peer must be started.

If it is not started, then (3) eventually fails, and kubeadm just returns the etcd API call error: can only promote a learner member which is in sync with leader. This error is ambiguous, because it can have other causes, like poor disk/network performance.

Moreover, if the etcd peer never started, then it can safely be removed from the membership list, and kubeadm should do that.
